description: Re-render an uploaded song as a cover: keep its structure/melody while changing timbre, instruments, or lyrics. INSTRUMENT SWAP: instruments {"piano": "electric_guitar"} separates the song, transcribes the swapped stem and re-plays THOSE transcribed notes on the target instrument; by default only the swapped stem(s) are regenerated and every other stem passes through as the original separated audio (regen changes that). Because the swap replays a transcription, small note differences from the source are expected — verify from result.cover.instrument_swaps (applied or why not), and offer the user the result/takes to judge rather than promising a note-perfect copy. Target ids: GET https://api.doseedo.com/api/instruments (open). Optionally export a DAW session too. Async: returns a job_id — poll with doseedo_wait_task (several minutes for full songs). Result files are pre-signed links: curl -OJ <url>, no auth header (valid 24 h). Cancel: a render that has not reached the GPU yet is stopped and its credits refunded; one already rendering finishes on the GPU (its credits are spent), the job ends as canceled and the output is discarded.

audio_key.description: R2 ingest key of an uploaded audio file (from doseedo_get_upload_url / POST /api/upload/r2/ingest-url; starts with "ingest/"). Provide this or audio_url.

audio_url.description: https URL of the audio, as an alternative to audio_key: a doseedo result URL exactly as a job returned it (a stem, a take, a bounce), or any public URL. The gateway fetches it (≤256 MB) into your account's ingest storage before the job starts. Pass audio_key OR audio_url.

cover_noise_strength.description: Optional 0–1 fidelity dial: higher departs further from the source.

drum_split.description: true = explode the covered drums into isolated kick/snare/hh/… stems, each generated from its own slice of the drum roll (result.drum_stems).

export.description: Optionally also build a DAW session for this target.

genre.description: Optional GENRE style transfer: free text naming the target genre (e.g. "bossa nova", "80s synth-pop"); every regenerated stem is captioned with it. Outcome in result.cover.genre.

guitar_split.description: Deal the guitar bucket into N players, each its own row/swap: "2"–"4", or "auto" (a one-vs-two probe decides). Outcome in result.cover.guitar_split.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Any unique string for THIS request (e.g. a UUID). Re-sending the same call with the same key after a timeout returns the same job instead of starting a second one.

instruments.description: Optional per-stem instrument SWAP map {source: target}, e.g. {"piano": "electric_guitar", "sax": "violin"}. Source = a stem (drums, bass, vocals, guitar, piano, other) or a detected instrument (sax, trumpet…); target = an instrument id from /api/instruments (an unknown target is refused up front).

labels.description: Optional identity CORRECTIONS {source: instrument}, same shape as instruments, e.g. {"other": "trumpet"} when the separation mislabels a stem. Only fixes what the stem is called (caption/timbre); nothing is re-played. Outcome in result.cover.stem_labels.

midi_only.description: Optional: re-perform every regenerated stem from its transcribed MIDI with NO timbre from the recording (the stem's own sound is dropped). Stems with nothing to render are skipped (result.cover.midi_only.skipped).

regen.description: Optional: which stems to regenerate. Default with a swap = only the swapped stems (the rest are the original separated audio). "all" = cover every stem; or a comma list of stems/instruments, e.g. "piano,other" (a swapped stem is always regenerated).

structure_key.description: Optional ingest key of audio whose STRUCTURE codes replace the source's (the Cover page's "Structure: custom").

style_key.description: Optional ingest key (upload it first) of a reference MIX whose TIMBRE the regenerated stems take on (style transfer).

swap_cns.description: Optional 0–1, only with instruments: how far the SWAPPED stems may depart from their source (overrides cover_noise_strength for them; server default 0.35). Lower = closer to the original timing/feel.

timbre_preset.description: Optional named timbre preset — the fallback rung of the timbre ladder (stem latent > this > stock bank).

name: doseedo_cover_song
